story.value: The name lead comes from the Anglo-Saxon word lead, which is of unknown origin.
The chemical symbol Pb comes from the Latin word plumbum.
Lead has long been known and is mentioned in Exodus.

uses.value: Lead is used to shield against X-ray and gamma-ray radiation in X-ray machines and nuclear reactors.
Lead is used to make lead-acid storage batteries, such as those found in automobiles.
Lead is used as a covering on some wires and cables to protect them from corrosion.
Lead oxide, a lead compound, is used to make crystal glass and flint glass.
